instruction: In apps/daemon/src/engine/claude-tui.ts and pty.ts, ptyEligible refuses host runs whose session env sets CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 (which dispatch sets on subscription-bound runs), preventing interactive engine PTY from starting. Pass the subscription OAuth token to the PTY child over file descriptor 3 (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR=3) while omitting CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from the child env, and allow subscription-bound host runs in ptyEligible (still refusing nested scrubbed daemon envs and orb sessions).
